webhooks.detail: Podio 'hooks' = webhooks; fire on item create/update/delete etc. per app, org, space; need verification before active.

evidence.quote: Hooks are webhooks that can call external sites when certain actions occur in Podio.

sandbox.detail: No dedicated sandbox, but API usable on free Podio accounts at no extra charge within base rate limits; test in a free workspace.

evidence.quote: The Podio API is available to use for both paid and free Podio accounts.

rate_limits.summary: 1,000 calls/hour general; 250/hour for rate-limited (resource-intensive) calls; per user per API key; 420 on exceed

evidence.quote: The general limit is 1,000 API calls per hour
